title: PanLink
description:
panlink.se PanLink AB is a Swedish contract manufacturer of cable harnesses, modules and complete assemblies, org.nr 556541-5295, Malmö, since April 1997.
It is wholly owned by the Fairford Holdings group, bought in 2006; the ultimate owner is the Osseiran family.
Production runs from Rokitki near Tczew, Poland (PanLink Sp. z o.o., KRS 0000355268), plus Bra, Italy; Sweden holds only the head office.
It serves rail and industry, with Alstom, ABB, Atlas Copco, Car-o-Liner, OXE Marine and Northvolt as customers and about 95 percent of sales exported.
Group revenue is roughly 354 to 362 million SEK with 340 to 370 staff, though the Swedish parent alone reports 11.2 million SEK and six employees.
The Polish plant lost 0.9 million PLN in 2023, 20.6 million in 2024 and 5.8 million in 2025 on 138.5 million PLN of sales, with 2.4 million PLN of equity against 98.9 million in assets.
Richard Alm became CEO in June 2026, replacing Lars-Gunnar Nilsson; ISO 9001, ISO 14001.
